env.vworldKeyDescription: Korean base maps, search, geocoding, and the cadastral/building/zoning layers come from VWorld, which requires your own API key. <keyLink>Request a key</keyLink>, registering the domain you will use it from.
env.vworldKeyConfigured: A key is saved — type a new one to replace it
env.vworldKeyStorageOs: Stored in your Windows Credential Manager for this user account. It is never written to the project file or shared with a project.
env.vworldKeyStorageMemory: Kept in memory for this browser tab only, and discarded when you reload or close it. Enter it again next session, or use the desktop app to store it.

credentialError.credential_backend_unavailable: The credential store is unavailable on this platform.
credentialError.credential_invalid_id: That credential is not one this app manages.
credentialError.credential_invalid_value: The value was empty, so nothing was saved.
credentialError.credential_read_failed: A saved credential could not be read. Delete it and enter it again.
credentialError.credential_write_failed: The credential could not be saved.
credentialError.credential_delete_failed: The credential could not be deleted.

env.credentialConfigured: A key is saved — type a new one to replace it
env.credentialStorageOs: Stored in your Windows Credential Manager for this user account. Never written to the project file or shared with a project.
env.credentialStorageMemory: Kept in memory for this browser tab only, and discarded when you reload or close it. Enter it again next session, or use the desktop app to store it.
env.credentialTestOk: The key works. The service accepted the request.
env.credentialTestUnreadable: Could not get an answer. The service does not send CORS headers on error responses, so a rejected key and an unreachable server look the same from a browser. Open the service's own page to check the key directly.

credentialTestFailed.invalid-key: The service rejected this key as unregistered. A newly issued key can take up to an hour to activate.
credentialTestFailed.access-denied: The key is recognized but not approved for this API. Apply for this specific service on the portal.
credentialTestFailed.rate-limit: The daily request limit for this key has been reached.
credentialTestFailed.invalid-request: The service rejected the test request.
credentialTestFailed.server: The service reported an error. Try again later.
credentialTestFailed.unknown: The key could not be verified.

env.dataGoKrKeyDescription: Weather, air quality, and the other Korean public-data services are published through data.go.kr and share one service key per account. <keyLink>Request a key</keyLink>, paste the decoded (not URL-encoded) form, then apply for each API you want on the portal — access is granted per service.
env.servicesIntro: One key covers your whole account, but each API needs its own 활용신청. An approval takes up to an hour to take effect, so a feature can still fail right after you apply.

servicesUse.villageForecast: Current conditions and the hourly forecast
servicesUse.airQualityReadings: What the air-quality stations are reading

ai.ollamaModelMissing: "{{model}}" is not installed on this Ollama server. Pick one below, or pull it with: ollama pull {{model}}
ai.ollamaUnreachable: Could not read the model list from the Ollama server, so these are suggestions. Start Ollama (or fix the Base URL) to list what is actually installed.

assistant.transmissionTitle: Before the assistant sends your data
assistant.transmissionProxy: This deployment's AI proxy, then its provider
assistant.transmissionContentsValue: Your question, plus each loaded layer's name, geometry type, feature count, and attribute field names. Attribute values are sent only when you ask for an analysis that reads them.
assistant.transmissionWarning: This leaves your device and goes to an external service. Nothing has been sent yet.

error.no-key: No KMA service key is configured.
error.network: Could not reach the weather service. The same error appears when the service key is not registered, has not activated yet (this can take up to an hour after signing up), or this particular API has not been requested for it.
error.timeout: The weather service did not respond in time.
error.invalid-key: The KMA service key was rejected. Check the key and its registered caller IP.
error.access-denied: Your key is not approved for this service yet. Each KMA API on the public-data portal needs its own request, and an approval can take up to an hour to take effect — check this API in 활용신청 현황, then try again.
error.rate-limit: The daily request limit for this key has been reached.
error.invalid-request: The weather service rejected the request.
error.no-data: No data for this point or time.
error.server: The weather service reported an error.
